title: Loa canonical finding (v1)
description: cycle-133 C-11 (FR-11; D-3.2 DEC-0849, D-3.5 DEC-0857): the one finding contract of every gate output (review, audit, Bridgebuilder, dissent). This file states the shape; the rules JSON Schema cannot state (the failure_scenario content rule, alias normalisation, id derivation, confidence normalisation) are stated in x-loa-rules and implemented identically by the four validators, which must agree on every vector under .claude/schemas/finding.vectors/{valid,invalid}/: the zod schema (.claude/skills/bridgebuilder-review/resources/core/finding-schema.ts), the jq validator (.claude/scripts/lib/finding-validate.sh), the python validator (.claude/scripts/lib/finding_validate.py) and the markdown bullet grammar of .claude/scripts/verdict-derive.sh (vectors carrying a markdown rendering). Properties not named here pass through unvalidated (category, anchor, evidence, enrichment fields); the normalised view keeps only the named fields.

id.description: Given, else derived: F-<first 6 hex of sha256 of the UTF-8 text '<file>:<anchor_line>:<title>'> (an absent part is the empty string).

file.description: Repository-relative POSIX path: non-empty, no leading '/', no backslash, no control character, no empty, '.' or '..' segment. Required for the defect severities.

anchor_line.description: 1-based head-file line. Required for the defect severities. An integral JSON number (12 or 12.0) is accepted and emitted as an integer.

anchor_line_end.description: Optional last line of a range; only beside anchor_line and >= it.

failure_scenario.description: The concrete failure: for CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM and LOW at least 12 whitespace-separated tokens or a 'when <...> then <...>' shape, and none of the denylisted phrases. PRAISE, INFO, REFRAME and SPECULATION are exempt (a value, when present, must be a string).

failure_mode.description: DEPRECATED alias of failure_scenario (removed in 2.1.0). Used when failure_scenario is absent, with the warning; present beside a different failure_scenario the finding is rejected.

description.description: Lowest-precedence alias source of failure_scenario (used when failure_scenario and failure_mode are both absent, with a warning). Never in conflict: a dissent or Bridgebuilder finding carries its human-readable description beside the scenario.

severity.description: Exact upper case. CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM and LOW are the defect severities.

blocking.description: A voice's blocking mark maps here. A blocking finding is tallied as blocking whatever its severity.

confidence.description: high | medium | low, or a number 0-1 normalised to the enum (>= 0.75 high, >= 0.45 medium, else low). Validators emit the enum.

x-loa-rules.whitespace: ASCII space, tab, LF, CR, FF, VT — the token separator of the content rule in every validator

content_rule.when_then: a token 'when' followed later by a token 'then' with at least one token between them and one after; tokens compared in ASCII lower case after stripping leading and trailing characters outside [A-Za-z0-9]
content_rule.denylist_match: case-insensitive, as a whole word or phrase (no ASCII letter or digit immediately before or after)

x-loa-rules.alias_conflict: failure_scenario and failure_mode both present (non-null) and not equal → rejected (alias_conflict)
x-loa-rules.alias_warning: `<alias>` is an alias of `failure_scenario`; removed in 2.1.0
x-loa-rules.markdown_grammar: - **SEV** (<items>) `file:line[-end]` <dash> <title>. Failure: <scenario>.  — the items, comma-separated in any order, are exactly one 'confidence: <high|medium|low>' and optionally 'speculative' and 'blocking'; the dash is one of — – - --; the clause starts at the last 'Failure:' outside backticks; one trailing '.' of the title and of the scenario is dropped
